messages:
olivia: FYI customer reported duplicate final tokens + double billing when their client reconnects quickly after an SSE disconnect. short repro attached.

customer_john: we saw 2 final completions for one prompt. client reconnect happened ~600ms after disconnect. charged twice.

mike_eng_oncall: can you paste the client repro (headers + small timeline)? any idempotency-key or resume token present?

customer_john: here: session_id=cli-9a2f, client-lib=js@1.3.2, requests:
```
-- initial connect --
POST /v1/chat/stream  -> 200 stream open, stream_id=srv-478
SSE: chunk x...
network drop ~t=0
client reconnect (600ms) -> new POST /v1/chat/stream (no Idempotency-Key header)
server resumed? returned final chunk again
```
We do send a "resume_token" from lib v1.3.2 but looks like it wasn't included in the reconnect POST (we're investigating client).

anna_sre: I pulled logs for stream_id=srv-478 and see two complete generate events within 1s of each other: gen-abc123 and gen-def456. Both have same prompt fingerprint but different internal request_id. There is a small race where the first in-progress output wasn't fully checkpointed to the session store before the reconnect landed, so the reconnect path triggered a fresh generation.

mike_eng_oncall: thanks. billing side: both generate events were billed as full completions. That explains customer charge.

olivia: customer asks if there's a server-side mitigation while they patch their client to always include resume_token and an Idempotency-Key.

anna_sre: short-term mitigation options: 1) enable server dedupe by prompt fingerprint + session_id for a 2s window (we can toggle per-tenant); 2) require resume_token presence to route reconnect to resumable session; 3) best long-term: make resume atomic (checkpoint before accepting reconnect).

teo_pm: operationally, option (1) is fastest. Does it carry correctness risk (dropping intentional retries)?

anna_sre: small risk: legitimate retries that intentionally resend with slight prompt edits could be deduped if fingerprinting is too lenient. We'll scope to exact prompt hash + session_id + recent source_ip. Should be safe for customer.

mike_eng_oncall: I can flip per-tenant dedupe for their org id (org-42) for the next 24h while they roll client fix. I'll also add a log marker so we can validate no false drops.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: toggle-dedupe-for-org-42 (canary -> 1 instance) by mike_eng_oncall.

olivia: customer confirmed they'd prefer the server toggle and will roll client patch in 48h. They want a written recap + how to avoid billing duplication.

anna_sre: recap (to send): root cause = race between reconnect path and session checkpointing causing server to treat reconnect as a fresh generation because request lacked Idempotency-Key/resume token. Workaround = enable per-tenant exact-prompt dedupe for 2s; recommended client fix = always attach resume_token and Idempotency-Key on reconnects; long-term fix = atomic session checkpointing before accepting reconnect. I'll include repro snippet and logs.

mike_eng_oncall: action items:
- flip dedupe toggle for org-42 (in progress)
- billing: create invoice adjustment if duplicate charge > 0 (tag billing-ticket #B-347)
- eng: schedule small patch to require resume_token on reconnects in next minor release (assign @client-lib-team)

customer_john: thanks all, appreciate the quick follow-up. we'll push client patch tonight.

olivia: closing loop once billing team confirms credit. will post final status here.

mike_eng_oncall: note for postmortem: add unit test covering reconnect accepted only after checkpoint write confirmed (race repro).

olivia: (reaction) :thumbsup:
